details: Bitcoin (BTC) experienced a decline, trading at approximately 62,829.17 USDT with a 0.51% decrease, and earlier at 62,982.96 USDT with a 0.07% drop within a 24-hour period on August 16, 2026.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $63,000 USDT

details: CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost reported that an estimated 3.56 million BTC are now considered lost, accounting for approximately 17.7% of the total circulating supply. This suggests a notable reduction in the amount of Bitcoin actively available for trading.
title: Lost Bitcoin Reaches Record 3.56 Million Coins

details: Michael Saylor, Executive Chairman of MicroStrategy, reiterated his conviction that Bitcoin's market capitalization will exceed that of gold and all other major asset classes within the next 48 months, emphasizing his long-term bullish outlook for the cryptocurrency.
title: Saylor Predicts Bitcoin as World's Largest Asset in 4 Years

details: Cboe BZX Exchange is seeking SEC approval for six new Volatility Shares funds, including 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs. These products aim to offer three times the daily performance of their underlying assets through futures, raising discussions about the risks associated with such highly leveraged instruments, especially after 2x funds experienced up to 96% losses.
title: Cboe Proposes 3x Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs

details: The 21Shares XRP ETF (TOXR) saw a significant decline in its assets under management, plummeting by 54% from $247.7 million to $112.9 million during the first half of 2026. This reduction was primarily attributed to substantial investor redemptions and a nearly 43% drop in XRP's market value.
title: 21Shares XRP ETF Assets Drop by 54%

details: XRP's price experienced a rebound on August 16, briefly dipping below the $1 mark before recovering to approximately $1.06 amidst market volatility. This movement occurred despite renewed criticism from veteran trader Peter Brandt, who expressed a preference for Bitcoin.
title: XRP Price Rebounds Above $1

details: Harvard Management Company maintained its $101.4 million investment in BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) throughout the second quarter of 2026. This decision marks a stabilization in Harvard's Bitcoin exposure, following two consecutive quarters of reductions.
title: Harvard Maintains $101M Bitcoin ETF Stake in Q2

details: Michael Saylor announced that while Bitcoin (BTC) saw a 47% decline over the past year, MicroStrategy's STRC preferred stock gained 9% in the same period. This highlights the differing performance between Bitcoin and MicroStrategy's structured financial products.
title: Saylor: Bitcoin Down 47%, MicroStrategy's STRC Up 9% in Year
